source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of collaborative problem solving (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Collaborative problem solving (mil jul kar masle hal karna) ka matlab hai doosron ke saath mil kar mushkilat ka hal dhoondna aur mushtarka (common) maqsad haasil karna. Agle do hisse is ki do shaklein batate hain: insaan aur machine ka saath kaam (human-machine collaboration), aur teamwork aur ilm ki sharing.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein collaboration (mil kar kaam) ki do qismein bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Human-machine collaboration (technology ke saath kaam), aur teamwork and knowledge sharing (logon ke saath kaam aur ilm baantna).

items: Mil kar masle hal karna: doosron ke saath mushkilat hal karna aur mushtarka maqsad haasil karna.
